Powersets.name: Willpower
Powersets.desc: You rely on sheer willpower to push through pain and adversity, gaining balanced defenses and regeneration.

powers.name: Indomitable Will
powers.desc: Toggle, Self +Def(Psionic), +Res(Disorient, Hold, Sleep, Immobilize, Fear, Confuse)

powers.name: Rise to the Challenge
powers.desc: Toggle, PBAoE Foe -To Hit, Self +Regen (increases with more foes)

powers.name: Heightened Senses
powers.desc: Toggle, Self +Def(Smash, Lethal, Fire, Cold, Energy, Negative)

powers.name: Strength of Will
powers.desc: Self ++++Res(All Damage except Psionic), ++++Res(Status), -Endurance Crash on fade
